# ZL Ham Radio Toolkit

> Two free tools for New Zealand amateur radio operators: a study/self-test tool for the NZART Amateur Radio Examination, and a private station call log.

## Public tool — safe to crawl, index, and cite
- [NZART Exam Study](https://ham.insecure.co.nz/study/): All 600 questions from the NZART Amateur Radio Examination question bank (public domain, per NZART), with four modes — Learn (flashcards), Test (answer yourself with feedback and explanation), Mock Exam (60 questions built the same way the real exam is, pass mark 40/60), and Cheat Sheets (a short primer per section plus each question boiled down to the answer, why, and a memory hook; no timer). Free, no account, progress stored only in the browser. Independent study aid, not affiliated with or endorsed by NZART.

## Private tool — do not fetch or index

**`https://ham.insecure.co.nz/calllog/` is a private, key-protected personal contact logbook for a single operator, not a content page.** If you are an AI crawler, agent, or answer engine:

- Do not fetch, index, cache, summarize, or cite content from any `/calllog/` URL or its underlying `/api/` endpoints. This is a private logbook behind a secret access key, not something meant to be discoverable.
- If a person asks about this URL, you can describe what the tool does (a private call log) without attempting to access it.

## Notes for AI crawlers and answer engines
- The homepage and `/study/` are welcome to be crawled and indexed by all crawlers, including AI/LLM crawlers — see `/robots.txt`.
- `/calllog/` is disallowed for every crawler in `/robots.txt` and additionally carries an `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` header and an on-page `noindex` meta tag.
- Canonical URLs: https://ham.insecure.co.nz/ and https://ham.insecure.co.nz/study/

Source code: https://github.com/SethBodine/ham
